name: B10-0067/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the November 2025 elections in Honduras, where the electoral council declared Nasry Asfura the winner but the result was disputed and a full recount was ordered. The Parliament asks all sides to respect the result, reject violence and support a peaceful handover of power. It also urges Honduras to carry out electoral reforms and calls on the European Union to keep watching the situation.

- The Parliament asks Honduras to respect the election result and keep the transfer of power peaceful.
- It calls for electoral reforms and full use of EU election observers' recommendations.
- The EU's diplomatic service and member states are asked to keep monitoring Honduras.
